name: Pixel Art
description: Draw pixel art on a 16, 24 or 32 grid with a retro palette, fill, picker, mirror mode and undo. Every drawing is kept and saved as a crisp PNG.
prompt: A pixel art editor with a 16, 24 or 32 grid, a retro 24-colour palette, pencil, eraser, fill bucket, colour picker, mirror mode, undo and a grid toggle, keeping every drawing and saving it as a crisp PNG.
